walkthrough: Goal: combine the layer I am on with the one below it, as Procreate's Merge Down does, without the picture changing at all, then keep painting on the result; undo takes the merge back in one step and reopening keeps it.

Entry: open OpenPaint on the tablet (2880 x 1800, landscape) on an empty library. Draw a black wave with the pen: it lands on Layer 1. Tap Layers, tap Add layer and draw an arc across the wave outside the panel: the panel closes and the arc lies on Layer 2.

Open Layers again. The footer holds, after Add Mask, a row with an arrow down onto a line and the words Merge Down. Tap Multiply: Layer 2 multiplies, Layer 1 stays Normal; Merge Down turns pencil grey and its row's right end says Modes clash, quieter (merged over Layer 1, the arc would no longer multiply what lies under the wave). Tap Clipping Mask: the arc shows only on the wave, and Merge Down is ink again. Slide Opacity to about 60 % and tap Add Mask; draw a black line across the arc outside the panel: the mask hides the arc there.

Merge: open Layers, tap Layer 2's row (its paint, not its mask, is chosen: the layer's options show) and tap Merge Down. Layer 2's row goes, Layer 1 is the chosen layer, its picture now shows the wave with the clipped, faded, masked arc on it; nothing on the canvas changes, not by one pixel (the clipping chain's composite is what the merged layer holds). Undo: both rows come back as they were (mask, mode, opacity, clipping); redo merges again.

Keep painting: draw a stroke across both: it lands on the merged layer above everything it holds. Undo and redo take that stroke alone. Adjustments, filters, smudges and transforms on the merged layer act on all of it.

Failure: Merge Down is grey with why at its row's end where the merge would change what shows: the bottom layer (Nothing below, also the bottom of a group), a hidden or locked layer (Hidden layer, Locked layer), two layers that composite by different modes or by Overlay when the upper one does not clip (Modes clash), an upper layer above a clipping layer it does not clip with (Below clips), an upper layer other layers clip to (Has clips), records nested more than eight deep (Too deep).
Reopen: leave the app and let the system close it, open it again: one layer with everything as merged, and the stroke on it.
